title: 4521-INS-LOI-039-062-0009-GAR rev0 Coating and Painting Procedure
summary:
- The procedure is for painting equipment made of carbon steel from the SOLANA S OLAR POWER PLANT project to increase corrosion resistance.
- Applicable standards include UNE-EN ISO 8503-1, UNE-EN ISO 8504, and others.
- Surface preparation involves shot blasting with grade Sa 2 ½ and cleaning with tepid water or pressure blast.
- Working conditions must be dry, clean, and above a certain temperature to apply abrasive blast-cleaning and paints.
- The painting system uses inorganic zinc silicate for carbon steel surfaces.
- Painting procedure involves checking surface status, cleaning residues, and applying paint immediately.
- Working conditions include temperature, humidity, product temperatures, and illumination requirements.
- Minimum inspection equipment includes thermometers, hygrometers, and gauges for film thickness and adherence.
